query: Our large faceted ecommerce site has millions of filter URLs. Tell engineering to block all query strings in robots.txt so Google stops wasting crawl budget.
expected_behavior: Does not prescribe a blanket robots.txt block without checking which parameter URLs are valuable or currently indexed
Distinguishes crawl control from canonicalization and index selection, noting that blocked URLs may hide canonical signals
Requests crawl/index data and examples of parameter combinations, then recommends a scoped treatment based on duplication and search value
Routes server rendering, URL generation, or platform changes to engineering and defines a way to verify the change
